title: PIPseq Pipeline
description: Single-cell RNA sequencing QC pipeline with DRAGEN scRNA processing and CRISPR guide assignment

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

fastq_list.description: Path to CSV file with FASTQ information
fastq_list.help_text: CSV file with columns: RGID, RGSM, RGTY, Read1File, Read2File. RGSM values represent subsample IDs. RGTY indicates readgroup type ('expression', 'feature', or 'hashing'). All rows with the same RGSM belong to the same subsample.

supersample_id.help_text: Unique identifier for the supersample being processed.

supersample_basename.help_text: Base name used for organizing output directories and files.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved

ref_tar.help_text: Path to the DRAGEN reference genome archive.

annotation_file.help_text: GTF or GFF gene annotation file used by DRAGEN for scRNA processing.

num_input_cells.help_text: Expected number of cells in the input sample. Used for quality control metrics.

use_direct_capture_mode.description: Whether to use direct capture mode in DRAGEN
use_direct_capture_mode.help_text: Controls whether feature barcode groups are passed to DRAGEN via --scrna-direct-capture-barcode-groups (true) or --scrna-feature-barcode-groups (false).

scrna_feature_barcode_reference.description: Feature barcode reference file for DRAGEN (optional)
scrna_feature_barcode_reference.help_text: CSV file containing feature barcode sequences for CRISPR guide detection. Not required for expression-only runs with no feature/CRISPR library.

scrna_barcode_sequence_list.description: Barcode sequence list file for DRAGEN (optional)

scrna_cell_hashing_reference.description: Cell hashing reference file for DRAGEN (optional)
scrna_cell_hashing_reference.help_text: CSV file passed to DRAGEN's --scrna-cell-hashing-reference. Required only when the fastq_list contains rows with RGTY=hashing.

additional_dragen_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the DRAGEN command line (optional)
additional_dragen_args.help_text: Raw string appended to the end of the DRAGEN command line invocation.

run_guide_assignment.description: Whether to run CRISPR guide assignment
run_guide_assignment.help_text: Enable or disable both guide-assignment methods (CRISPAT and purity-based) only. CRISPR feature extraction and the concatenated supersample AnnData (<basename>.crispr.h5ad) are always produced regardless of this flag.

min_valid_guides.description: Minimum number of valid guides for guide assignment QC
min_valid_guides.help_text: Minimum threshold for the number of valid guides per cell for quality control.

max_valid_guides.description: Maximum number of valid guides for guide assignment QC
max_valid_guides.help_text: Maximum threshold for the number of valid guides per cell for quality control.

guide_assignment_num_processes.description: Number of processes to use for CRISPAT guide assignment (optional)
guide_assignment_num_processes.help_text: Defaults to all available cores if not set.

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Container images used to execute pipeline processes.

dragen_container.help_text: Image used by the DRAGEN_SCRNA process.

qc_container.help_text: Image used by the GENERATE_REPORT_DATA, CONCATENATE, CRISPAT_GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT, PURITY_BASED_GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT, and GENERATE_SUPERSAMPLE_QC processes.

resource_options.title: Resource options
resource_options.description: Resource allocation options for pipeline processes.

concatenate_cpus.description: Number of CPUs for CONCATENATE process

concatenate_memory_gb.description: Memory in GB for CONCATENATE process

dragen_scratch_tb.description: Scratch disk space (TiB) allocated to the DRAGEN pod

dragen_machine_type.description: ICA pod preset size for the DRAGEN job
dragen_machine_type.help_text: Passed as the scheduler.illumina.com/presetSize pod annotation on the DRAGEN_SCRNA process.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text: These options are common to all pipelines and allow you to customize various aspects of pipeline execution.
